headline: Jio IPO draws massive demand to become India's largest-ever public offering
summary: Jio's initial public offering received overwhelming institutional and retail backing, drawing over 7.40 lakh crore in bids and setting a world record for applications.
why: Record-breaking mega-IPOs absorb significant domestic and international liquidity, acting as bellwethers for investor appetite in major emerging market tech sectors.

impacts.name: Indian Telecom and Technology
impacts.why: Massive capital inflows and high subscription rates validate strong market valuation metrics for dominant telecom platforms.

why_moved: Overwhelming subscription demand from institutional and retail investors drove the offering to historic funding milestones.
